paragraphs.text: Liont was a human smith and former werewolf in the province of Kessig on Innistrad .

During to the Cursemute , Liont’s werewolf nature was completely cured, and his business was booming. However, when Avacyn became corrupted by the presence of Emrakul , and the Cursemute ended, he uncontrollably turned into a werewolf and killed his whole family. The morning after, when he realized what he had done, he called for Avacyn in despair, and she answered the call, breaking through the roof of his house. In answer to his prayer, she shot a blast of white light from her spear, killing him.
